title: Completed projection and trace-transpose maps
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$, a morphism $f:X\to Y$ and a compactification $c$. Use the completed integral categories and normalized ringed tensor/pullback models $a$ with open comparisons $b$. For objects $T$ on $X$ and $K$ on $Y$, assuming invertibility of the ordinary-to-completed comparison $\chi$ on $(P_cT,K)$, define adicProjection by $\chi_Y^{-1}$, the canonical ringed compactification projection, and $P_c$ applied to the ordinary pullback-completion unit followed by $\chi_X$. For $t:P_cT\to\mathbf1_Y$, define adicTraceTensor by $\chi_Y^{-1}$, ordinary $t\otimes1$, the specified ordinary-tensor realization and its left unitor. When that actual projection is invertible, define adicTraceMap by its inverse followed by adicTraceTensor. In the finite-field finite-type setting, for the specified exceptional adjunction system $S$, finite-Tor objects $A,K$ and $v:P_cA\to K$, define adicTranspose to be the ambient arrow of the exceptional Hom bijection applied to the left realization followed by $v$. These are composite maps with given invertibility witnesses, with no invertibility or shift-coherence assertion. Constructions used: [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-pur-conventions], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], [def-pur-integral-ringed-projection-maps], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements].

def adicTraceMap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (d : RingedModels l E) (b : RingedOpenComparisons l E d) (c : Compactification f)
    (T : Integral l E X) (K : Integral l E Y)
    (h : IsIso (((d.tensor Y).chi l E).app
      ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) c).obj T, K)))
    (hp : IsIso (adicProjection l E d b c T K h))
    (t : (PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) c).obj T ⟶
      (calculus l E Y).integralClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit)
